title: The build store cannot travel between campaign members
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)

evidence.verified: The store tests in tests/test_record_build.py pass. In them, `CS_BUILD_STORE` names the store outright, and a store that is a git repository gets a commit for each build. The take-in test pushes to refs/campaign/orchestrator, and `record-build.sh store` takes it in, fast forward and by a merge. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 7f94c70.

resolution: `CS_BUILD_STORE` names the store directory outright. A store that is a git repository keeps each build as a commit, and takes in what the orchestrator delivered before it is read or written. The campaign's member fetch merges a fetched store at once.
details: A campaign member's store is found by owner, and inside a member the fallback owner is the host user's name, since every checkout sits in the home directory. So a member cannot be pointed at the store a campaign hands it. The store is also a plain directory: `make ci` leaves new builds as loose files, and nothing takes in the builds the orchestrator delivers to a member's clone.
